decks.notes: This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. It's centered around disrupting the opponent's hand with discard spells like Thoughtseize and pressuring them with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief. The deck also includes powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to dominate the board. By controlling the game early on and maintaining pressure, this deck aims to outpace and overpower the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to use creatures with various abilities to create a toolbox of options that can be searched for using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. The deck aims to establish a board presence with efficient creatures like Delighted Halfling and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician while utilizing sacrifice synergies with cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Zulaport Cutthroat. Agatha's Soul Cauldron provides additional value by recurring creatures from the graveyard. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons to control the game state.

The main theme of this deck is to use the synergy between Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands like Simic Growth Chamber to generate massive amounts of mana and play Primeval Titan to search for powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. This allows the player to assemble a quick combo and overwhelm their opponent with powerful threats. The inclusion of cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove helps ramp up mana production and fix the player's mana base for optimal performance.

This deck focuses on using Cascade spells like Ardent Plea and Shardless Agent to manipulate the graveyard and bring out powerful creatures like Striped Riverwinder and Waker of Waves. The goal is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures and then cast Living End to return them all to the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of creatures. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan, allowing the combo to go off smoothly.

This aggro deck focuses on utilizing a variety of colors to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. The deck aims to control the board by removing threats with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, while also utilizing Leyline of the Guildpact to maximize the power of its multicolored creatures. By combining efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu with powerful enchantments like Scion of Draco and Leyline Binding, the deck seeks to maintain pressure on opponents and close out games quickly.

This deck focuses on combining powerful lands with creatures like Primeval Titan to create a fast and explosive ramp strategy. By utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, the deck aims to generate huge amounts of mana quickly and efficiently, allowing for big plays in just a few turns. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and The Mycosynth Gardens enables the deck to tutor for key pieces and create additional threats on the board, making it a versatile and aggressive combo deck in the Modern format.

This deck aims to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate, while also disrupting opponents with Thoughtseize and Force of Negation. Atraxa, Grand Unifier helps to control the board and protect our combo pieces. Tainted Indulgence allows us to draw cards while Faithful Mending helps us filter through our deck and find our combo pieces. Fallaji Archaeologist helps us reanimate creatures from the graveyard. Overall, the deck focuses on quickly assembling its combo pieces and overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game using various ramp spells and mana acceleration to quickly set up a win condition with Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Scapeshift. By ramping into multiple lands with Farseek and Sakura-Tribe Elder, the deck aims to generate enough mountains to deal massive damage to the opponent when Scapeshift is cast. The inclusion of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and The One Ring helps to further ramp and fix mana colors, while Lightning Bolt and Worldsoul's Rage provide additional removal and reach.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures to create a powerful toolbox that can be accessed using Chord of Calling. The creatures in the deck provide support through abilities like sac outlets, life gain, and creature removal. The deck aims to control the board through creature interactions and gain incremental value. With strong mana acceleration from cards like Wall of Roots and Gilded Goose, the deck can quickly establish a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing low-cost, aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes powerful cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Grief, and Dauthi Voidwalker to apply pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Angrath's Rampage. Additionally, the deck features a few high-impact cards like Liliana of the Veil and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to provide additional value and versatility. The goal of this deck is to maintain a fast-paced, aggressive tempo while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells and removal while slowly building up to powerful endgame plays with The One Ring. By using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils to disrupt the opponent's game plan and generate card advantage, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Solitude and Leyline Binding provides additional control and protection for key threats, allowing the deck to dictate the pace of the game and secure victory through patient and strategic play.

This mono black control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Sheoldred's Edict. The deck also utilizes powerful threats like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to control the board and pressure the opponent. Additionally, the deck has card advantage engines like Dauthi Voidwalker and Castle Locthwain to help maintain resources. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent with efficient removal and resilient threats, ultimately grinding out the game for a win.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through the efficient use of UrzaTron lands to ramp up mana and play high impact spells and creatures. The deck utilizes powerful cards such as Karn, the Great Creator, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to dominate the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes control elements like Oust, Wrath of God, and Reprieve to manage threats and maintain board advantage. Overall, the goal is to establish control early and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats later in the game.

The focus of this deck is to efficiently cycle through cards and disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up for a powerful Living End combo finish. By using cards like Shardless Agent, Grief, and Architect of Will to manipulate the board and hand, the deck aims to control the game until it can cast Living End to bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard. Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional disruption, while Waker of Waves and Curator of Mysteries contribute to card draw and filtering. Overall, the deck seeks to outmaneuver opponents and overwhelm them with a sudden onslaught of creatures.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Boseiju, Who Endures. The deck also includes cards like Transmogrify and Persist to help set up the combo. Thoughtseize is included for disruption, while Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push provide removal. Dwarven Mine and Commercial District help provide additional mana sources, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can be used to create tokens. Overall, the deck aims to be creative in its approach to winning through powerful combos and disruptive plays.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach to combo off with key cards like Grinding Station, Mishra's Bauble, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to generate infinite loops and dig through the deck quickly. It also utilizes Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By leveraging the graveyard as a resource, the deck aims to find its win condition, such as Thassa's Oracle, to secure the game. The inclusion of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's interaction.
